# SQL workspace

## Summary

AcmeLake includes a browser-based SQL workspace where analysts write queries, save worksheets and
share results with teammates. Queries run on elastic compute pools that can be paused when idle.

## Details

- Saved worksheets.
- Compute pools pause when idle.
